name: art-deco
summary:

taste.note: Revised the ROXY cinema from v1 without changing its massing, tower, sunburst or marquee. The 344 teal side and back panels are now black (the entrance field is muted cyan terracotta), and the posters use only yellow, black and white. I added a light weathering and subtle variation pass to the cream, quartz and blackstone, plus eight planter beds on the pavement in front of the wings. Check shows 0 floating blocks and the renders read as Art Deco with a tower; `build.nbt` is saved and `v1.nbt` is unchanged.
